ratingMethod.Covered: At least two relevant requests without explicit friction; request coverage only, not demonstrated successful performance.
ratingMethod.Critical: At least three relevant entries, with explicit friction in at least two and at least half of relevant entries.
ratingMethod.strengthBasis: Relative friction profile only; task frequency alone does not establish capability.
ratingMethod.attributionLimit: Reported errors are evidence of task friction, not proof that this agent caused them.
